The ten blocks the bar was fixed over: the eight a reviewer flagged on 2026-09-21 and 2026-09-22, in
the ledger domain as the writer-eval cases carry them, and the two residuals the landed rules carry at
k17 and k07, each as a run wrote it and a reviewer read it. The reader answers `cannot say` on
every one, or the gate is deleted.
